method.name: milp_lot_sizing
steps: Define sets: products {I, II, III}, quarters {1,2,3,4}
Parameters: demand[p][q] from Table 1-10, prod_hours[p] in {2,4,3}, capacity=15000 h/qtr, backlog_cost[p] in {20,20,10}, inv_cost=5, final_stock=150, no initial stock, I cannot be produced in Q2

Decision variables: x[p][q] = units of product p produced in quarter q (integer, >=0), inv[p][q] = inventory of product p at end of quarter q (integer, >=0), back[p][q] = backlog of product p at end of quarter q (integer, >=0)

Constraints: (1) Flow balance per product per quarter: x[p][q] + inv[p][q-1] - back[p][q-1] = demand[p][q] + inv[p][q] - back[p][q]; initial inv/back at q=0 = 0; (2) Final stock: inv[p][4] = 150; back[p][4] = 0; (3) Capacity: sum_p x[p][q]*prod_hours[p] <= 15000 for all q; (4) No product I in Q2: x[I][2] = 0
Objective: Minimize sum_pq back[p][q]*backlog_cost[p] + sum_pq inv[p][q]*5

method.name: milp_inventory_backlog_multi
steps: Define sets and parameters same as milp_lot_sizing
Decision variables: x[p][q] production, i[p][q] inventory, b[p][q] backlog (all integer >=0); additional variable s[p][q] net stock = i - b for tracking
Per-quarter per-product stock dynamics: s[p][q] = s[p][q-1] + x[p][q] - demand[p][q]; s[p][4]=150; s[p][q-1]+x[p][q]-demand[p][q] >= -M*b[p][q] and <= i[p][q] to decompose into inventory and backlog

Alternative simpler formulation: separate inventory and backlog as independent non-negative variables with auxiliary constraints ensuring only one is positive at a time (or both allowed if partial deliveries permitted)
Same capacity and no-I-in-Q2 constraints as milp_lot_sizing
Objective: minimize sum_pq i[p][q]*5 + sum_pq b[p][q]*backlog_cost[p]

method.name: milp_compact_production
steps: Compact formulation: minimize sum_pq (5*inv[p][q] + back[p][q]*comp_cost[p]) subject to
Inventory flow: inv[p][q] = inv[p][q-1] + x[p][q] - demand[p][q] + back[p][q] - back[p][q-1] (accounts for unmet demand becoming backlog)
Initial: inv[p][0]=0, back[p][0]=0; Final: inv[p][4]=150, back[p][4]=0
All variables non-negative integers; back[p][q] and inv[p][q] are separate variables
